summary:
Reviewed a033c460 (bc517d85 rebased; identical on its 7 files), the one commit of w205 between ready -> claimed and claimed -> done.
r34-r39 are implemented as planned. r39 reads only .shop/work/<i>/raised.jsonl (reading A, as ruled).
No test removed or weakened. Step widenings change no assert, and the allowance rows hold. Nothing under features/ changed.
Fix now (Important): `work show q1`, `show p1` and `show initiative` print a request, a proposal or initiative.md as a work-item and exit 0, because workqueue.find globs */<name>.md and kind is not checked (probe reproduced).
Observations: a malformed raised.jsonl line crashes `list` with a KeyError traceback; `list --json` does not carry r39's waiting; open_with_proposal ignores {state}.
Lint introduced: F401 unused Refused import, RUF015. Other ruff/vulture hits were already there. No file over 300 lines.
questions: Important, fix now: scripts/workqueue_list.py:58 (work_item, via show at :74): `work show <name>` resolves any .shop/work/*/<name>.md, so a request (q1), a capability-proposal (p1) or initiative.md is printed as a work-item and exits 0, where r37/r7 call for a refusal; fix: refuse when the file's kind is not work-item.
